First, I really like this website! Reddit totally needs competition and improvement.

My biggest wish would be to divide the front page into Subverse Sections, like any news site does (Google news, etc.). Or at least make it an option. (Yes RES dashboard widgets lets you do it but it's a big pain to manually set up and has drawbacks)

  1. Subdividing makes it easier to scan posts and organize it in your brain. (And makes it easy to tell if there are new stories in a topic) No one would ever want Google or any news site to list stories from all categories in one big random stream. I never understood why aggregation sites settle for doing it like that.

  2. It would be a huge improvement on default reddit, and a hugely visible difference. (And by making it a default feature instead of an add-on it could be much sleeker-looking than RES widgets)

  3. The first section should be "Overall Top", just like "Top stories" in Google etc. (This is not possible in RES, as far as I know.)

  4. To handle large numbers of subverse subscriptions, you could stop after say 10 sections (user selectable) and the last section could be "Miscellaneous".

I personally think this would be a game-changing feature. Imagine someone going to something that looked like Google News, and allowing voting, posts, and indented commenting on every single story.
